item.title: Hermantown’s Adan Sandoval-Luna to Play College Football at Bethel
item.description: HERMANTOWN, Minn.- Another Hermantown Hawk will suit up for Bethel next season. Offensive and defensive lineman Adan Sandoval-Luna announced his commitment to the Royals last week. Just this past year, he had 15 solo tackles with 29 assists. He was also named all-section and was named to the all-Northeast Red district team. Categories: High School, Sports
